title: CameraService Wakeup Troubleshooting
content: CameraService may fail to initialize during vehicle wakeup. Check CAN communication and camera initialization timing. Known solution is to use the updated initialization sequence introduced in Camera Stack 4.2.3.

title: CAN Gateway Startup Problems
content: CAN gateway communication problems after ECU restart can be caused by incorrect startup ordering. Updated gateway software contains the corrected initialization sequence.
